'''Jaminere''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], along the [[Cadinth Run]]. A powerful manufacturing world known for its efficiency, Jaminere was the capital of the [[Allied Tion sector/Legends|Allied Tion sector]].<ref name="Xim Week" />

==History==
Prior to [[25,150 BBY]], Jaminere was the capital world of one of the ancient Tion Cluster states: the [[Kingdom of Jaminere]]. Jaminere later allied with the Kingdoms of [[Kingdom of Cadinth|Cadinth]] and [[Kingdom of Barseg|Barseg]], creating the [[Three Allied Kingdoms]]. [[Pirate King/Legends|Pirate King]] [[Xer VIII]] waged a campaign against the kingdoms between 25,150 BBY and [[25,130 BBY]], defeating the Kingdom of Jaminere at the [[Battle of Jaminere]]. Jaminere and the Three Allied Kingdoms worlds were conquered and absorbed into [[Kingdom of Cron|Xer's Empire]], and later [[Xim's empire]].<ref name="Xim Week" />

After the collapse of the empire in [[25,100 BBY]], the world became the center of the [[Jaminere Marches]], one of the feuding states that rose in the Tion Cluster from the ashes of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot's]] empire in the century after his [[Death/Legends|death]]. In the following centuries, Jaminere's rule stretched from [[Embaril]] and [[Desargorr]] to [[Amarin]] and [[Argai]], and its influence endured as late as the era of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].<ref name="Xim Week" />

After the [[Tionese War]], Jaminere and the entire Tion Cluster joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In the Republic's final years, the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] worlds joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]], and were later subjugated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that created the Allied Tion sector. Thus Jaminere was made the sector capital.<ref name="Xim Week" />
